sourceText:
Mustard and Honey Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 29, 2009 - 11:04pm

Ingredients




4 chicken breast halves without skin boned
2 teaspoons prepared mustard
2 teaspoons honey

Preparation

1 Spray the unheated rack of a broiler pan with nonstick spray coating. Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt. Arrange chicken on broiler rack. Broil 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 6 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl stir together mustard and honey. Brush over chicken. Broil 1 to 2 minutes more or till chicken is tender and no longer pink.
